C9000067.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 067 (The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six.; papers: The Campana–Peternell conjecture in dimension six; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C67_CORE_AUDIT.statement: Independently verify the pseudoindex-five numerical implication, or refute a precise asserted intermediate statement with a premise-complete witness.

C67_NUMERICAL.statement: The actual pseudoindex-five universal family implies 3S^2-20SD+32D^2=0 with D>0.

C67_UNIVERSAL.statement: The minimal family is smooth and proper and has connected evaluation fibres and every-member splitting T_e|C=O(-1)^3.

C67_INVOLUTION.statement: The rational cohomology of the projective-line fibration has the stated involution and integration product rule.

C67_DESCENT.statement: The shifted Chern classes r,s,t descend using the actual degree-one line bundle A.

C67_HODGE.statement: The relative Hodge bundles for evaluation over the simply connected projective base are trivial.

C67_GRR.statement: Positive-degree direct images of td(E) and td(E)ch(E dual) vanish.

C67_MATRIX.statement: All six row families of A annihilate the geometric weight-nine intersection vector.

C67_PRODUCTS.statement: The tangent-map polarization is ample and selected intersection coordinates factor as the normalized xi_i eta_j.

C67_FINITE.statement: For the exact rational matrices defined in the manuscript, xi_0=eta_0=1 and N(xi_i eta_j)=0 imply 32-20eta_1+3eta_1^2=0.

C67_DIRECT_LIFT.statement: Explicit rational row operations on A produce selected-coordinate relations with exact lifts to the geometric row families.

C67_DIRECT_CUBIC.statement: An explicit rational linear combination of quadratic invariant multiples of the lifted relations equals the target cubic functional.

C67_MODULE_IDENTITY.statement: Explicit degree-two rational polynomial cofactors of lifted selected-coordinate relations sum to the target degree-three module element.

C67_RATIONAL_KERNELS.statement: Exact rational identities AK=0 and NP=0 together with four valid modular rank bounds certify the rational kernel and selected annihilator.

C67_CUBIC_UPPER.statement: Exact finite-field slice compatibility gives cubic kernel dimension six, hence the rational cubic kernel has dimension at most six.

C67_CUBIC_BASIS.statement: Six exact rational cubic columns satisfy every double-slice constraint, have nonzero minor -16/5, and annihilate the quadratic target functional.

C67_CP6_MAIN.statement: Every smooth connected complex Fano sixfold with nef tangent bundle is rational homogeneous.

C67_PICARD.statement: The Picard-number-at-least-two case is covered by Kanemitsu Theorem 0.2.

C67_REDUCTION.statement: Picard-number-one sixfolds outside projective space and the quadric reduce to pseudoindices four and five.

C67_D4.statement: The pseudoindex-four sixfold case is homogeneous.

C67_RECOGNITION.statement: The numerical constraint, tangent-image geometry, and citation-faithful recognition hypotheses identify the pseudoindex-five sixfold with Gr(2,5).

C67_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.statement: The scoped mathematical certificate has passed Host-invoked independent Reviewer replay; novelty and significance have been assessed separately.

F067_KANEMITSU_EVERY_MEMBER_SPLITTING.statement: In OpenAI Family 067 (Campana-Peternell in dimension six, 02-minimal-curves.tex and 04-characteristic-classes.tex), Kanemitsu (2016) Proposition 1.6 supplies every-member splitting T_e|_C = O(-1)^3 across all fibers (rather than only general fibers) needed for base-change descent lem:shifted-descent.
